headline: Binance says withdrawals are still due to restart today, Sunday 1 Nov, after it replaced about 90% of the stolen crypto, but it has not given a time.

market.asOf: No price snapshot this edition: CoinGecko and CoinMarketCap could not be read at about 19:56 UTC Sat 31 Oct. Use the live prices at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: Not read this edition: alternative.me and CoinMarketCap's Fear and Greed pages could not be opened.

stories.title: Binance withdrawals still due today, Sunday 1 Nov, with no time given
stories.summary: Binance says it has replaced about 90% of the assets taken in the hack and still plans to restart withdrawals on Sunday 1 Nov. It will reopen in stages and has not given an exact time. Sources differ on when the full Proof of Reserves (a public check that customer balances are fully backed) will land: Monday 2 Nov or Tuesday 3 Nov.
points: Binance says it has replenished 90% of the roughly $6.3B taken, up from about 80%, and set aside more than $6.34B, including $5B it already held in the affected tokens, per CoinDesk.
Ten tokens are fully covered: BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC, XRP, USD1, RLUSD and ZEC. The rest, less-liquid tokens, is being bought on the market and in private (OTC) deals, per CoinDesk.
Withdrawals are still planned for Sun 1 Nov, with specifics to be announced separately once confirmed, per TechFlow. crypto.news says the reopening will happen in stages.
A reserve snapshot was taken at 00:00 UTC on 31 Oct. CoinDesk and TechFlow say the full proof is due by 3 Nov; crypto.news says results are expected by Monday 2 Nov.
Binance co-CEO Richard Teng said investigators found more ways in than the employee laptop first suspected, per CoinDesk.

stories.title: Stolen bitcoin still parked as October closes with big ETF outflows
stories.summary: Trackers give slightly different totals for how much was stolen and frozen, so each is named. The 18,270 stolen bitcoin has not been sent to any service, while US spot bitcoin funds had their biggest one-day outflow since June on Friday, as October came to a close.
points: Amount stolen: Elliptic says $6.43B, TRM Labs $6.36B and Binance about $6.3B.
Frozen: Binance and partners about $3B (CoinDesk); Elliptic $2.85B; TRM about $2.7B as of 30 Oct. Elliptic says about $3.21B is in assets that cannot be frozen.
Elliptic says the 18,270 stolen BTC sits in 19 addresses and none of it has gone to a service; CoinDesk says 17 of those wallets hold 1,000 BTC each.
US spot bitcoin ETFs had net outflows of $643.2M on 30 Oct, the largest since June, per crypto.news.
CoinGlass, via Cointelegraph, had bitcoin on track to end October about 7.7% lower, its weakest October in about 12 years.

stories.title: The hack becomes an election-week fight in Washington
stories.summary: With the US midterm elections on Tuesday 3 Nov, officials and lawmakers are using the Binance hack to argue over the CLARITY Act, a crypto bill to regulate exchanges that has stalled in the Senate.
points: President Trump said he was looking into the hack, per The Block.
Senator Cynthia Lummis said the CLARITY Act would have given crypto firms legal cover to freeze suspicious transactions, per The Block.
CFTC Chair Michael Selig called offshore exchanges like Binance unregulated, per The Block.
All 435 House seats and 35 Senate seats are on the ballot on 3 Nov, per CryptoTicker.
Prediction markets on 30 Oct gave Democrats 92-94% odds to win the House and 69% for the Senate, per CryptoTicker.

briefs.title: Chainalysis confirms a break-in
briefs.summary: Chainalysis says an attacker reached customer user IDs, names, emails and role labels, but not investigation data, credentials or session tokens, per The Hacker News.

briefs.title: Tether reports Q3 profit
briefs.summary: Tether reported $1.5B of operating profit for the quarter and reserves of $191.5B, nearly $8B more than its liabilities, per Investing.com on Yahoo Finance.

briefs.title: Coinbase Q3: revenue down, profit up
briefs.summary: Revenue was $1.22B, down 35% from a year earlier; net income was $719M, including a $715M gain on crypto it holds, per The Block.

briefs.title: Trezor warns of a possible tampered device
briefs.summary: Trezor says anyone who bought a device from reseller CryptoBilis since March 2026 should move their funds now, after a report of a cellular implant in a Safe 5, per The Block.

briefs.title: Strategy changes its preferred-stock dividends
briefs.summary: Holders approved dividends that accrue daily, starting 1 Nov for STRC, and MSTR fell 8.7% on Friday morning, per The Block.

briefs.title: Big bitcoin options expiry next Friday
briefs.summary: About $2.065B of bitcoin options expire on Fri 6 Nov, with a put/call ratio of 0.32, per TokenPost.
